in_marathi.name: अमन
in_marathi.long_meaning: अमन हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, the name अमन (Aman) signifies that which is immortal and imperishable. It is a name of Lord Indra, the God of Thunder and Rains in Hinduism. The name represents the power and strength of the divine and is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune.
